description: Runs one calculator from list_calculators on your numbers and returns the headline result, the supporting figures, a one-sentence reading, and a link that opens the calculator with the same inputs. Missing inputs use the calculator's example values. Enter percents as points (15 means 15%), choices as the option index.

currency.description: Currency for money results. Default USD

slug.description: Calculator slug from list_calculators, e.g. holdout-test-calculator

name: run_calculator
title: Run a Spillmark calculator
